duration.text: The Logistics Engineering at University of Science and Technology Beijing is a 3 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 4388 USD/per year ￥ 31600 CNY/per year

materials.text: 1. Photocopy of valid passport With photo, passport number &expiration date and name included. 2. Passport-sized photo A passport-sized photo taken recently of the applicant. 3. Bachelor's degree diploma Graduation certificate should be in Chinese or English.If not, it should be translated into Chinese or English and be notarized. 4. Transcript of undergraduate school 5. HSK Certificate (No need for English-taught program) Level 6 or above 6. Health certificate(optional) Photocopy of physical examination record. 7. Two recommendation letters(optional) 8. A letter from a sponsor From professor,associate professor or equivalents.

requirements.text: 1. Hold a Bachelor's degree diploma 2. Under the age of 35 3. HSK level 6 or above
